The project's CLAUDE.md names place 1234567890, so I'll use `Sword Arena - 1234567890` (id `3f9a2c`). I'll start with a read-only search for every reference to `GiveCoins`.

The search found five references. Before editing, I'll read the full Rewards module and the AdminCommands line, since `"GiveCoins"` there is a string and may be a command name rather than a function call.

Two findings:

- `AdminCommands` maps the chat command `/coins` to the string `"GiveCoins"`, then calls `Rewards[method]`. The string is the internal method name, not the player-facing command, so it has to change to `"AwardCoins"` and the `/coins` chat command stays the same.
- The other four are direct references, and `DailyBonus` aliases the function as `give`.

I'll make all five edits now.
Every edit applied. I'll grep again to confirm no references to the old name remain.

`GiveCoins` is now `AwardCoins` in `ServerScriptService.Rewards`, and all four callers are updated. A follow-up search finds no `GiveCoins` left in the place.

- **`KillHandler`**: `Rewards.GiveCoins(killer, ...)` → `Rewards.AwardCoins(killer, ...)`
- **`DailyBonus`**: `local give = Rewards.GiveCoins` → `local give = Rewards.AwardCoins`
- **`Shop.Refunds`**: `Rewards.GiveCoins(player, price)` → `Rewards.AwardCoins(player, price)`
- **`AdminCommands`**: the string `"GiveCoins"` in the `COMMANDS` table is now `"AwardCoins"`. It's looked up as `Rewards[method]`, so it had to change with the function. The `/coins` chat command is unchanged, so admins will see no difference.

local Rewards = {}

function Rewards.AwardCoins(player: Player, amount: number)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins and coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		coins.Value += amount
	end
end

return Rewards

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Rewards = require(script.Parent.Rewards)

local KILL_REWARD = 10

local function onCharacterAdded(character: Model)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator") :: ObjectValue?
		local killer = tag and tag.Value
		if killer and killer:IsA("Player") then
			Rewards.AwardCoins(killer, KILL_REWARD)
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Rewards = require(script.Parent.Rewards)

local give = Rewards.AwardCoins
local DAILY_BONUS = 50

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.wait(2)
	give(player, DAILY_BONUS)
	print(`[DailyBonus] {player.Name} +{DAILY_BONUS} coins`)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Rewards = require(script.Parent.Rewards)

local ADMINS = { [1029384756] = true }
local COMMANDS = {
	coins = "AwardCoins",
}

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
		if not ADMINS[player.UserId] then
			return
		end
		local command, targetName, amount = string.match(message, "^/(%a+) (%S+) (%d+)$")
		local method = command and COMMANDS[command]
		local target = targetName and Players:FindFirstChild(targetName)
		if method and target then
			Rewards[method](target, tonumber(amount))
		end
	end)
end)

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Rewards = require(ServerScriptService.Rewards)

local RefundIssued = ServerStorage.Events.RefundIssued :: BindableEvent

RefundIssued.Event:Connect(function(player: Player, price: number)
	Rewards.AwardCoins(player, price)
end)
